dog.description_text:
Meet Hot Chocolate!
Who could say no to a cup of Hot Chocolate? This handsome boy came to ACC as a stray, so we're still learning all about his past. He's shown us that he's curious, enjoys sniffing around, and is happy to come over for some attention. He can be a little shy when something catches him off guard, but give him a moment and a little encouragement, and you'll see him start to relax. He's hoping to find a cozy home where he can settle in and show off his sweet side!

My Ideal Home
Hot Chocolate would love a calm, patient home where he can take his time getting comfortable. He's still a young guy with plenty to learn and discover, so daily walks, sniffing adventures, food puzzles, and fun enrichment games will help keep him happy and busy. Most importantly, he'll need a family who understands that the best things take time and lets him explore the world at his own pace.

Good with Other Pets?
Hot Chocolate came to us as a stray, so his history with other dogs is unknown. When he spotted another dog during an introduction, he decided he'd rather head back inside than say hello. For now, dog parks aren't his cup of cocoa, and any potential dog siblings would need thoughtful introductions at his pace.

Good with Kids?
Hot Chocolate's history with children is unknown. A quieter home with patient family members who can give him space as he settles in would be a lovely place for him to start his next chapter.

Things to Know
Hot Chocolate can be a little sensitive about being touched, and his skin condition may be contributing to some of that discomfort. It's best to go slowly, let him approach when he's ready, and never rush him into pets or handling. He's a sweet boy who deserves the chance to feel safe and comfortable in his new surroundings. His care team can share more about his skin and any care he may need. With a cozy spot to call his own, a little patience, and lots of love, Hot Chocolate is ready to warm up to his forever family!
dog.name: Hot Chocolate
